description: A residential exterior wall vignette photographed at standing eye-level in a three-quarter view of a stone corner. The sky above is a pale overcast dusk grey. The overall palette is warm ivory stone, matte black-bronze hardware, green climbing vine, and green topiary forms in the soft background. The mood is traditional, handsome, and warmly classic — the exterior wall of a well-appointed stone house at dusk. Camera is at standing height, using a normal-to-slight telephoto lens, looking level at the wall in a three-quarter angle revealing the stone corner and the climbing vine. The composition is tightly cropped to emphasize the material texture and the warm wall glow.
